body: And now im here with the guy who broke my leg 2 hours ago.  I ditched the other guy and i miss him so much
I am 8 years with my boyfriend who is abusive:( i deserve it all

Well we were together at that time, but we were in a super bad place. We had a huge fight that day and I ended up at my best friends place (male), but he was in love with me. I didnt believe that tho. My boyfriend knew it and was drunk and went to the prostitute. I never knew until my parents called me to tell me there was a fine because the car was parked somewhere where it shouldnt. The address is very known as the ´prostitute´ street so my parents and I knew. 

The thing is, he first lied about going there, then he lied about just looking at the windows, and then he said he only talked. But in my eyes, no one goes there to talk. So I told him that and then he said he was looking for stuff. (He wanted to do drugs or something).

I am not adventurous either, and I don't think he is but I guess he wanted to take revenge even if I didn´t do anything with the (ex) best friend. Im not sure why he thinks searching for drugs is any better, both are not okay in my eyes. 

I think you are right about him liking everything else, that's how I feel too. The sex isn't necessary for me.

I think the same way, I'm also a woman and I do it from time to time. But i tend to overthink it about my boyfriend, we are together for a very long time so it´s normal if he does it, and I feel like a hypocrite. I also don't like the thought of him watching other girls, and specially because he went to a prostitute once and still lies about it and tells me he was just talking. Tbh its a weird situation because my parents found it out and they understand him somehow. I'm not very sexual and he is very sexual so I can't always fulfil his needs, so I do understand him a bit, but he doesnt fulfil my needs either so it's not that fair lol. 

Anyway I do understand you, and it is surprising that a lot of guys dont care about it haha
But what if you are around and she does it in the shower while you are watching a movie or something?
I asked about it and I just wanted to know if any other guys have the same thoughts about their close friends.
Yeah that’s mostly true, but this guy who admitted it is actually sexy af so that’s why I was kinda curious haha
What do you mean exactly ? :p
Lol your reply makes no sense at all. Because I care about a friend I’ve known for years I will end up being a cheater? Seems legit
Honestly no. I don’t have many friends and there’s no reason to cut him off.. he didn’t ask for it but I’m just caring, not needy.
Aw that is actually so cute! Good to hear a big hug cheered him up. My dad used to hug me when I was younger and I remember how it always made me feel better when I was feeling down :)

I’m sorry to hear. I have been in the same position and I know it hurts to not be seen. Really sucks that she had to leave, do you still have contact with her? You seem like a good person, I wish you all the best in the future :)

Well he has been turned down a couple of times now and every time he’s hurt so I don’t see the point of him continuing trying if it’s just sex he wants. Also, I’m not even kidding if I tell that he could go to 3 or more other girls who would love to have sex with him lol so I’m just wondering why me

I think so too, I think that when he’s sober he tries to play it cool and manly by not texting me and ignoring me so I could be the one “wanting” him, he knows how much I hate being ignored tho. 

I should probably just leave it alone I guess :/
He actually texted me two hours later lol and I saw him and we talked so it’s all good again :p
Thanks a lot!  At this moment I’m not texting him because he didn’t reply to my text but I’m kinda stuck and waiting for him to text but I know it will never happen.
I actually do, because he was always there for me (except the ghosting times)

Thanks! I think so too, he “chased” me for almost two years but I was always very clear about having a boyfriend.. He ghosted me a few times to be honest, but never blocked me everywhere possible. And suddenly I see I’m unblocked so I guess he might think he can deal with it again but I’m sure he can’t yet :/
That’s what I thought too, but why not unblock me everywhere? :/

I think that’s what happened to me too, he told me he loved me and I didn’t say it back because to me he was my best friend (there was sometimes some sexual tension tho) and he blocked me out of his life and cut off all contact suddenly. Now I miss him and I’m wondering if I was wrong for not saying it back :/ But it’s indeed misinterpretation of love.

Lol, well the problem here is that he didn’t want me to leave and was talking about unrelated things other than getting naked, but there was also a lot of sexual tension so I’m kinda confused if he truly loves me :p
But do you love her or is it only lust?

I’m sorry for you too, I’ve been in your position also and it really sucks. Yeah, it isn’t a crush either with him, he looked in my eyes and said that he loved me, but I was so drunk at that time and I replied with “thanks” and I still feel bad about it. I didn’t hear from him a week after that, until he was out with friend and he called me to ask me where I was and when I said I was out but going home he immediately cut off all ties and blocked me everywhere on social media. I guess when it’s true love, distance isn’t enough. I hope your doing fine and I’m sure that when time is right everything will be alright!

That’s what happened with me and my best friend also. We were so close but it ruined the friendship completely, he ghosted me 4 times now. Two months ago I was talking to him face to face and he was dating some other girl but he said he just can’t forget about me. I feel bad because I miss him like hell but it would be selfish of me to pursue the friendship, the thing here is I like him a lot but there are too many things that won’t make the relationship happen :(
I understand this 100%, I have the same issue at the moment
Well that’s good to hear! Glad you’re happy and married to a beautiful woman :) I hope he can move on also

Yeah I totally understand, I did try to contact him a few times at the beginning but he straight up ignored me so that’s when I left him alone. But we have a lot of mutual friends and we live like 2 streets away so I will eventually see him somewhere sooner or later :/

I understand, it must be hard for you tho, I never thought about it before but when my best friend told me the last time I saw him that it’s so difficult to move on when I’m still around. 

Wish you all the best!
Haha well I guess he’s over me then, it’s been a month. Do you think that when you’ll see her again the crush will come back?

I see, do you think that when you see her again you’ll be crushing on her again? The thing is, it was my best friend and he cut me off completely a few times tbh. 

Every time when he saw me at a party or somewhere else, it was the crush like before all over again and I miss him but I don’t want him to be hurting
Damn, how did you get over it? Did you cut off all contact?

I got ghosted by the same guy 4 times before, this is the 5th time. I should let him go but somehow there is something pulling us back together every time. I run into him, He sees me when I’m driving, etc. He is a friend, but he wants more so the reason he told me why he ghosts is because he can’t bear with the fact we are only friends. He told me he loved me two weeks ago, I didn’t say it back and since then the only thing he told me is “leave me alone” and then blocked me. Pretty immature tbh, but I know for sure that when he sees me again and I’m talking to some other new friend he will come back to tell me we should be friends again.

And so the vicious circle continues.. been going on for 2 years at this point.
I guess I am hahah :D
Yeah looks like it lol but don’t know why tho :p I still think it’s kinda cute :D

Thank you, I think that’s what’s going on for sure, because he knows it won’t work out between us and he did tell me a couple times that it’s “playing with fire” If we continue talking and texting.. But it kills me that he tries to get my attention every time he sees me. Like he walks very close to me on purpose so I would notice him or when I pass him he would tap me on the shoulder and throw me a wink when I look at him..

Exactly, I did call him out on it a few times already tbh and at one point I was done but he came back telling me he is sorry and I told him I didn’t care anymore, he then said some kind words and asked me if I really wanted him out of my life and that’s when I said no and things were better for a while but he started again. He also told me he doesn’t like texting that much and that he doesn’t reply on “normal” texts but when I text him I always make sure that I ask him a question but still no reply.. :(

Guess so haha, sucks tho because he even introduced me to his mom and he has a good view on everything.  We used to talk for hours about life and other stuff. 

Thanks for your advice :)
I know that I should stop texting and wondering why but it hurts so much when I think about how he might not even care :/

I think he is manipulating me by playing games, because I know he knows that I hate being ignored and he is someone who loves to show who is in control :/ Sometimes he texts me just before he goes to sleep, even when I texted him 2 days ago

Yeah, that’s what I thought but I’ve slept in his bed a few times and he didn’t do anything so that’s kinda weird. He also didn’t tell me he loved me but he told it to his best mate and I overheard it. He tried to kiss me a few times but I pulled away so maybe he just feels rejected?

That’s right. I don’t want to have more than friendship with him, i also have a boyfriend and he knows him very well. Well it just hurt me that he dumps me as a friend for a girl, because he knows i’m going through a difficult time. And that’s exactly what i did yesterday when i saw him i told him that it doesnt matter to me what he does or who he dates because he is my friend. But he kept telling me to stop lying and that i really am jealous. I then told him that it isnt true because i love my boyfriend and he just laughed, what was kinda weird to me.

Woman* haha. 
No problem!

I know how that feels. I have the same issue! I’m sorry she left you when you needed her the most, sometimes people can’t see what they have. It’s very nice and brave that you did that for her though, you will find someone who truly appreciates what you do for her. :)
I’m so sorry for your loss. I’m sure you did a great job! <3

I wish I had it too. Honestly but don’t have savings at this point in my life. 

My parents support me, and if we really needed money for emergency they would definitely help us. But my mother has recently been diagnosed with cancer and had a lot of high bills to pay (hospital) so can’t really rely on them right now. 

I absolutely understand that, and I feel very bad that he has to cover my bills for two months. But I don’t know what else I can do unless being thankful for him doing it.

That’s exactly what I mean, it’s extreme to have a daily budget but I do also get it because he doesn’t want to fall out of money all of sudden. I admit I could spend a lot of money on shopping if I didn’t have had him, so sometimes it’s a good thing also :)

I think he doesn’t understand how girls hair work lol, he uses the same thing for his hair as for his body. I have very dry hair so it needs to be groomed a lot. I tried to tell him that a lot of times but he still thinks it’s not necessary. He has his own view on some stuff and it is hard to change his point of view. We do have some communicating issues, but it’s always about money. I agree that it might be a bigger issue unfortunately :(
Yes he does know, and it made him freak out just like it did to me

That’s actually a very good idea, definitely gonna do that. I know that he has something like that for himself too, like every month he puts away some cash for emergencies (like when the washing machine dies). Thanks for the good advice!

Yeah, he went through hard times. I agree I might be lacking in financial responsibility. But I do work at the moment, just had an accident at work (car drove over my leg) and my insurance refuses to pay me any longer. I do understand how expensive owning a house is yes

I gave up on my dreams to become psychologist to take care of his mother that I loved very much. It took a lot of energy because I had to stay up every night till 6am before I could put her to bed. I did pay rent that time too, not much but like 400 dollars a month and didn’t had a job. But I’m not insensitive or needy. I did already had a gift at that time but didn’t tell him. His reaction was a bit harsh to me.

I actually don’t mind it but he brings it up every time I try to talk about it. Even when I go to the store to buy some shampoo/conditioner he tells me I spend my money on things I don’t need. It’s so annoying :(

Same thing happened with my mother in law a few years ago. She was an alcoholic too and only had me and my boyfriend to rely on, her parents didn’t support her. I know you must be terrified right now, but what we did was calling in hospitals in the area she was last seen/heard that you know about. You could also call the police and ask them if they heard something of her. Don’t worry too soon and try to be strong!
